title: Closed Areas Regulation, Schedule 3, section 69 (Nisg̱a'a Highway)

source.version: BC Laws consolidation current to October 13, 2026

source_text:
Schedule 3 No Shooting or Hunting Areas (Section 4)
Nisg̱a'a Highway
69 That portion of the Province of British Columbia within 400 metres of the road allowance of Highway 113 between Sterling Mountain Parking Lot Recreation Site and Kincolith (Ging̱olx) and east to Nass Camp that is highlighted in yellow on the attached map 'Closed Area No. 3-69/26'. [en. B.C. Reg. 97/2026, App. 1, s. 2.]
